business_problem: UTAS needed to reduce the time students, researchers, and staff spent navigating course materials, research documentation, ethics approvals, and administrative submissions because manual academic workflows were slowing support and innovation.
solution_summary: UTAS partnered with IBM to build the AI CourseMate project as a practical agentic AI layer for higher-education workflows. Students and researchers co-developed the experience in the School of ICT using IBM watsonx.ai to build the assistant logic and IBM watsonx Orchestrate as the central low-code orchestration platform for the agents. Hosted on IBM Cloud, the MVP connected academic content and process context so users could retrieve course information, support research documentation, and move through ethics and administrative tasks from one interface instead of bouncing between manual steps. UTAS also used IBM watsonx.governance to monitor, track, and manage the AI models so the deployment stayed aligned with the university's emphasis on safe, ethical AI. The result was a scalable support pattern that combined retrieval, orchestration, and governance for student and research operations.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx.ai
solution_components.role: Provides the AI studio used to build the assistant logic for academic and research workflows.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx Orchestrate
solution_components.role: Acts as the core platform for the agents that guide users through academic information and process steps.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx.governance
solution_components.role: Monitors and manages the AI models used in the university deployment.

solution_components.name: IBM Cloud
solution_components.role: Hosts the minimum viable product that serves students, researchers, and staff.

data_flow: Course materials, research documentation, ethics-approval context, and administrative inputs are routed through watsonx Orchestrate, watsonx.ai generates responses and task guidance, watsonx.governance tracks model behavior, and the IBM Cloud-hosted MVP returns the result to students and staff.
business_outcome: UTAS validated that agentic AI could improve academic support and administrative throughput while giving students practical AI experience and preserving responsible-governance controls.
metrics: 90.9% response accuracy in answering user queries
